title: Turkey taco soup
summary: Turkey taco soup is a mexican dinner built around turkey breast mince and canned black beans, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Warm the oil and soften the onion for Turkey taco soup. Stir in the garlic, ginger and spices until they smell fragrant.
steps.tip: If the spices look dusty, give them a minute in the oil before any liquid goes in.

steps.instruction: Add turkey breast mince and cook until it loses its raw look. Pour in the tomatoes or coconut and canned black beans.
Simmer gently, lid ajar, until chopped tomatoes is tender and the sauce coats a spoon. Add a splash of water if it sticks.
steps.tip: Taste Turkey taco soup before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Taste for salt and acid, then rest the pan for a couple of minutes before serving Turkey taco soup.
